title: Five Young Women Outdoors, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from the mid-1940s featuring five young women sitting together on a log outdoors, likely at a summer camp or ranch given the horses and sign reading 'HORSE' partially visible in the background. They are dressed in typical mid-century casual attire, including cuffed jeans, saddle shoes with bobby socks, striped t-shirts, and plaid button-down shirts. The photo features deckle-cut edges and a vertical light leak or exposure defect through the center.
